name: baseline
note: no overrides -- the control arm. ALWAYS include one: without it you are comparing arms to each other with no anchor, and a corpus/commit drift shows up as every arm regressing.

name: vpc_zero_cli
note: a parameter that is a CLI FLAG rather than a module constant: rewrite it in the manifest. Anchor the pattern tightly -- a loose one rewrites more of the chain than you intend.
